ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

3. When practising Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Attentive listening.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Attentive listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

4. When practising Phonics, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonics.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Phonics.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonics.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Phonics.

5. When practising Pre Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Pre Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Pre Reading.

6. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. Where is the library?
   C. where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

7. When practising Pre-Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Pre-Writing.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Pre-Writing.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Pre-Writing.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Pre-Writing.

8. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. quickly

9. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

10. When practising Language Welcome and, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Welcome and.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Language Welcome and.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Welcome and.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Language Welcome and.

11. When practising Language School, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language School.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language School.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Language School.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Language School.

12. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Language Welcome and and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Language School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Pre Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. D — went

3. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive listening.

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Language School; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
